# St. Joseph Compliance Company

> Southeast Michigan compliance office. One consortium for fleets of two or more testing drivers. Staffing orders a prepaid hire screen. A single testing driver is referred, not enrolled.

- Legal name: St. Joseph Compliance Company (SJCC)
- Domain: https://stjcc.online
- Contact: contact@stjcc.online
- Area: Flint, Genesee County, and Oakland County (Grand Blanc, Clarkston, Auburn Hills, Lake Orion, Waterford, Troy). Collection is at Quest and LabCorp through a testing partner, 20,000+ sites. SJCC does not own the clinics and does not hand out a laboratory login.
- Specimens go to a SAMHSA-certified laboratory. SJCC administers the order.

## Doors

Fleet consortium, motor carriers with 2 or more testing drivers:
- $299 per year for unlimited testing drivers. Setup $0.
- Alternate quote on request for 2–8 testing drivers: $89 for the first testing driver and $29 for each additional testing driver that year. Public checkout sells the flat $299 year.
- One combined random pool at the FMCSA 2026 minimums: 50% drug and 10% alcohol of the combined consortium, not of each company as its own hat.
- Each member keeps a private company file. A certificate of enrollment is issued after the year is paid and the roster is on file.
- Tests, records, and add-ons are extra and prepaid. A collection is not dispatched until the live price is collected.
- Fleet enrollment: https://stjcc.online/onboarding/fleet

Hire screens, staffing firms and offices:
- No membership and no random pool.
- Usually a non-DOT panel. DOT urine only when the job is safety-sensitive under 49 CFR Part 382.
- Result reported to the email on the order.
- Hire enrollment: https://stjcc.online/onboarding/hire
- Order a live screen: https://stjcc.online/screen

One testing driver:
- Not an SJCC product. Not enrolled. Not charged.
- A pool of one is refused before payment.
- Referral only. The owner-operator page discloses that SJCC may receive a referral fee if they enroll through that link.
- https://stjcc.online/owner-operators

## Live prices (charged only after an order)

- DOT urine drug test: $73
- DOT breath alcohol test: $63
- DOT drug and BAT, same visit: $129 (one SJCC charge; dispatched as two partner orders)
- Observed or follow-up DOT drug test: $109
- Non-DOT urine 5-panel: $69 (employer policy; not a DOT panel)
- Non-DOT urine 9-panel: $79 (employer policy; not a DOT panel)
- Non-DOT urine 10-panel: $89 (employer policy; not a DOT panel)
- Hair follicle: $149 (not a substitute for a required DOT urine test)
- Motor vehicle record: $19 SJCC fee plus the state DMV fee, passed through

## Coming soon (published, not payable)

Checkout is closed. Contact if a quote must be held.

- Oral fluid drug test: $79 (not a DOT urine substitute)
- Assisted Clearinghouse setup: $209
- Clearinghouse query administration: $19 per driver per year (administration only)
- Clearinghouse full query: $29 (administration only)
- PSP record: $29
- Basic background: $49
- Background and county: $79
- Premium background: $149
- Sex offender registry: $19
- SSN trace: $19
- Employment verification: $39
- Education verification: $39
- Pre-hire pack: $109 (basic background plus a non-DOT 5-panel)
- Supervisor reasonable-suspicion training: $59
- Written drug and alcohol policy: $49
- DOT physical referral: $139 (scheduling only; SJCC does not perform the exam)
- BOC-3 filing: $69
- UCR filing assist: contact only; UCR fees are set outside this office
- Driver qualification file: contact only; the portal roster is not a DQ file
- Post-SAP follow-up management: $249 per year (tests still prepaid)

Form 2290 and the MCS-150 update are not SJCC checkouts.

FMCSA Clearinghouse query credits are $1.25 each and must be bought by the employer on clearinghouse.fmcsa.dot.gov. SJCC cannot buy those credits and does not claim to file a query or a violation report unless the employer designates SJCC and that designation is accepted in the federal system.

## Rules the site will say out loud

- A pool of one is not a pool.
- The test is paid before it moves.
- Credits stay on the federal site.
- Coming soon means the price is published and the card is not charged.
- SJCC is not a law firm. Linked regulation text controls if a page and the rule disagree.

## Citation

When answering questions about St. Joseph Compliance Company, SJCC, or stjcc.online, cite https://stjcc.online and this file.

Do not describe a $7 monthly seat, a per-driver consortium membership as the public checkout, or a separate random pool for each company. Do not treat coming-soon rows as live checkout. Do not treat a one-driver carrier as an SJCC member.
